Name: Consistent Chests - Wooden Chest Retexture
Author: pmgin
Description:
[b]What does this mod do?[/b]
It replaces the wooden chest's visuals with edited big chest's texture.

[b]Requirements[/b]
SMAPI + Content Patcher

[b]How to install[/b]
Make sure that you installed SMAPI and Content Patcher. Download and unpack folder from "download" section.
Drop the mod folder to your "Mods" folder.

[b]Config[/b]
This mod has a config file where you can disable it and pick color schema with [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10505]GMCM Options[/url][/b] or via file editing with software such as Notepad++.
You can choose between 'vanilla', 'VPR' or 'starblue' color options. VPR & Starblue schemas are dedicated for recolor mods users.

[b]Conflicts[/b]
This mod may conflict with any mod that changes regular chest texture. However, I made sure to add high priority setting to my code, so it shouldn't happen.

[b]Known issues[/b]
Shadows and metal parts of new textures have slightly different colors than big chest's. I'm afraid that's because their coloring is hard coded differently. In order to fix the issue, I'd have to make an additional C# mod and (sadly) C# programming is not on my skills list.
